title: Reconstruction, emulator and static-recompilation maintenance
summary: Review eleven material upstream changes across reconstruction fidelity, emulator scheduling, static recompilation, enhanced Amiga variants and reverse-engineering tooling.
notes: The CPU audit queue contained zero unresolved source/target CPU areas, so this pass resolved zero CPU audit areas rather than inventing work. Primary commits and pinned documentation were reviewed; no upstream project was compiled or executed, and no runtime minimum was inferred from platform, source language, guest benchmark recipes or broad architecture family.

target_cpu.narrative: The retained output is native Motorola 68000 assembly, verified upstream against the original binary through the existing C/vasm route.

build.narrative: The primary change restores six recovered projectile-creator callers, types their storage roles (including type 12/25 writes and the steered-projectile path), and rejects 24 orphan layout coordinates while retaining the existing byte-exact Starglider 2 generation route.
build.next_action: Continue classifying the remaining unresolved record accesses and qualify behavior without promoting local exactness to complete reconstruction.
build.limitations: These are upstream targeted checks and generated-output claims; the tracker did not run the generator or game, and the remaining unresolved accesses still require semantic classification.

runtime_profiles.narrative: The reviewed creator-contract receipt does not state a minimum Amiga CPU, RAM, chipset or ROM configuration.
runtime_profiles.next_action: Add a runtime profile only when primary documentation or qualified hardware/emulator testing states a concrete minimum configuration.

relationships.narrative: The current restoration remains within the Starglider 2 target and does not resolve the wider predecessor, successor or credited-source graph.
relationships.next_action: Revisit project relationships after the bounded restoration stabilizes.
